To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
3-gram and dependency-based features are the most effective for the task of citation sentiment analysis, with 3-gram features outperforming the dependency based ones.

1) sentence splitting is not an effective feature for citation sentiment analysis; 2) the best performing feature is the dependency feature; 3) the best performing classifier is a Naive Bayes classifier; and 4) citation sentiment polarity is highly related to the sentiment polarity of the paper in which it is cited.
3-gram features and dependency relations are most useful in the task of sentiment analysis of citations.
